items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: That was, a lot of good guys in the band you might remember... brass section, Russell, Red and me, Russell playing first, I was playing second and Red was playing third. Hilton Jefferson playing first alto, Procope, Buster Bailey, Coleman Hawkins, Russell Toco (?) ... Walter Johnson, John Kirby and

ctx.x: Yeah. They were doing all right there and very well respected people. And he would call in a fellow from St. Joe and he played violin and he used to work with Coleman Hawkins and his-name-is and I can't think of his name offhand right now but I will sometime later on.
That's where Coleman Hawkins came from.
